items.originalTitle: The mistakes that cost Lewis Hamilton a podium at F1’s US GP
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton explained why he narrowly missed out on the podium at the United States Grand Prix, attributing it to what happened in free practice.
detailZh: 美国大奖赛上让刘易斯·汉密尔顿错失领奖台的失误
汉密尔顿在奥斯汀与领奖台擦肩而过，他认为原因出在自由练习阶段。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿解释了为何在一级方程式美国大奖赛上与领奖台擦肩而过。
这位法拉利车手从第五位发车，起步时超越伊萨克·哈贾尔升至第四，尽管首段比赛中他是唯一使用旧软胎的车手。
但在那一段里，汉密尔顿每圈比队友夏尔·勒克莱尔慢了0.277秒，也比使用新软胎的马克斯·维斯塔潘慢了0.422秒。这几秒正好对应了这位英国车手在奥斯汀比赛尾声错失超越维斯塔潘获得第三名所需的时间——或许也错失了超越勒克莱尔升至第二名的机会。
据这位七届世界冠军所说，早期速度不足的主要原因是他第一段中的次优调校——这是在自由练习中走错方向的后果。
“基本上，我在前两段里缺乏速度。我就是无法让赛车转向，”汉密尔顿说。
“归根结底，这一切多少始于周五。第一次练习赛的调校确实错了，第二次练习赛又走错了方向，后来改回去，在第三次练习赛中才达到更好的状态。
“但查尔斯和我的车之间有一个细微差别，基本上，只是在比赛中。这主要与襟翼有关，也就是你投入多少翼片，而我认为我们一直调得不够——不知为何一直调得不够。
“当你在发车格上做暖胎圈时，感觉赛车很好。可一旦比赛开始，就出现严重的抓地力流失和转向不足。我对此无能为力，所以他们就这么拉开了。我损失了那八秒，这确实是我最终没能拿到那个[第三]位置的原因。”
他补充道：“在进站期间，我加了四格[前翼角度]，下一次进站我又加了四格，可即便如此，我还是差了四格。落后十二格简直疯狂。我们真的需要研究一下是怎么走到那一步的。
“但我认为，如果我们在第二次练习赛就用上它，情况会有所不同，因为在那里你做了长距离跑。查尔斯就是在那里获得了那套调校的经验，而我没能用它做长距离跑。”
“所以，就像我说的，我一开始有点处于劣势，但有很多积极的地方可以吸取。车队在维修区停站和策略方面做得非常出色，我们今天显然有不错的速度，尤其是最后一段。如果我在前两段就有那样的速度，我们肯定能登上领奖台。”
汉密尔顿的挣扎因轮胎选择而加剧；他确实在最后一段换上了硬胎，而不是最初计划的另一套中性胎，但损害已经造成。
“我选择了两条中性胎，因为他们认为硬胎不会有什么好处，”他解释道。“事后看来，两条硬胎会是更好的选择——硬胎是最好的轮胎。
“然后这意味着我开始时用的是旧软胎，从旧胎到新胎，是两秒的比赛时间差距。而且这还影响了起步，相比其他都用新胎的人。我前面的所有车都是新胎，但我的起步非常好，差点就到第三名，但查尔斯抢到了外侧，我没能利用好那个机会。”
汉密尔顿还因晚些时候虚拟安全车出动而受到影响，当时是为了回收瓦尔特利·博塔斯那辆抛锚的凯迪拉克。他更新的轮胎意味着他每圈能追近维斯塔潘近一秒，但这次中立化打断了他的追击。
当被问及如果没有虚拟安全车情况是否会不同时，汉密尔顿回答：“大概我会和马克斯有一番小缠斗，可能是在最后几圈。是的，那会很棒。但正如我所说，我认为这一切都是前两段 驾驶阶段的结果，我在那里损失了太多时间。未来我不能放弃那段时间。
“我真的觉得自己对驾驶方式感到满意。只是花了整整两段 驾驶阶段才让这辆车转向。然后当第三段 驾驶阶段开始转向时，我又跟上了前面车手的节奏。但差距很大需要缩小。距离前车有八、九秒还是多少，而那些家伙显然非常快。所以，我只需要努力不再损失那段时间。”
与此同时，勒克莱尔为法拉利拿下了连续第三次领奖台完赛，但对最终落后分站冠军基米·安东内利13秒感到失望。
“我很享受，”这位摩纳哥车手评论道。“起步很有趣，之后与兰多[诺里斯]和马克斯再次较量也相当有趣。所以，这是那种你在驾驶舱里不会太无聊、并且有目标可争的比赛之一。
“我甚至一度以为胜利是可能的，当我看到基米（安东内利）选择一停策略时。根据我们的数据，他在比赛尾声会开始更吃力一些。他在比赛尾声其实从未真正吃力过，但是，是的，这是一场有趣的比赛。遗憾的是我们差一点就能获胜。”
法拉利目前已经连续九轮未能获胜，尽管近期有令人鼓舞的迹象，勒克莱尔不确定自己能否很快将速度转化为胜利。
“我能否将其转化为胜利有点难以预测，因为差距如此细微，这也取决于其他车队在接下来比赛中的升级计划，”他说。
“但赛车给我的感觉正变得越来越好。这些赛车非常特殊且独一无二，我觉得在过去两三场比赛中，我在驾驶方面又重新解锁了一些东西，尤其是在结合我驾驶风格的调校方面。两者结合在一起，我们向前迈进了一步，我现在对赛车的感觉舒服多了。
“所以我希望这能很快带来一场胜利。无论是在新加坡还是在这里的奥斯汀，我们都非常接近，所以我有信心，我们会在赛季结束前有机会赢得一场比赛。”
detailEn: The mistakes that cost Lewis Hamilton a podium at F1’s US GP
Hamilton narrowly missed out on the podium in Austin, which he reckoned was down to what happened in free practice
Lewis Hamilton has explained the reasons why the podium narrowly eluded him in Formula 1’s United States Grand Prix.
The Ferrari driver started from fifth on the grid and jumped Isack Hadjar for fourth at lights out, despite being the only driver on used (soft) tyres for the opening stint.

But Hamilton lost 0.277s per lap to team-mate Charles Leclerc during that stint, as well as 0.422s to Max Verstappen, with the pair on new soft tyres. Those few seconds corresponded to the time the Briton was missing to beat Verstappen to third at the end of the Austin race – and perhaps surpass Leclerc for second.
The main reason for that early lack of pace, according to the seven-time world champion, was his suboptimal set-up in the opening stint – the consequence of pursuing wrong avenues in free practice.
“I was lacking pace in the first two stints, basically. I just couldn't turn the car,” Hamilton said.
“Ultimately, it all kind of started on Friday. Wrong set-up really for FP1 and went the wrong direction in FP2, reverted back and got to a better place in FP3.

“But there's a subtle difference between Charles’ and my car, basically, just in the race. It's just to do mostly with flap, how much wing you put in, and I think we've just been under-hitting it – continuously under-hitting it for some reason.

“When you do the laps of the grid, it feels like the car is good. And then as soon as the race starts, it's just massive washout and understeer. I couldn't do anything about it, so they just pulled away. I lost those eight seconds, and that was really why I didn't get that [third] position in the end.”

He added: “Through the pitstops, I added four clicks [of front wing angle], the next pitstop I added another four clicks, and even then, I'm still another four clicks too short. And it's crazy to be 12 clicks down. We really need to look at how we get into that point.

“But I think it would have been a bit different if we had started with it in FP2, where you did the long run. That's where Charles got the experience on that set-up, and I didn't get the long run on it.

“So, as I said, I got a bit on the back foot, but lots of positives to take from it. The team did a really great job with pitstops and the strategy, and we obviously had a decent pace today, particularly the last stint. If I had that in the first two, we would have for sure been on the podium.”
Hamilton’s struggle was compounded by his tyre choice; he did switch to the hard compound for the last stint instead of another set of mediums as initially planned, but the harm had been done.

“I chose to have two medium tyres because they didn't think the hard tyre was going to be any good,” he explained. “In hindsight, two hard tyres would have been the better one – the hard tyre was the best tyre.

“And then it meant I started on a used soft which, from used to new, is two seconds of race time. And it affects the start as well compared to others that are all new. All the cars ahead are new, but I had a really good start, nearly got to third place, but Charles got the outside and I didn't get to capitalize on that.”

Hamilton was also hindered by the late virtual safety car intervention to recover Valtteri Bottas’ stricken Cadillac. His fresher tyres meant he was catching Verstappen by nearly one second per lap, but the neutralisation thwarted his recovery.

When asked if things might have been different without the VSC, Hamilton replied: “Probably I would have had a little bit of a battle with Max, maybe the last couple of laps. Yeah, that would have been awesome. But, as I said, I think it was all a result of the first two stints where I just lost so much ground. I can't be giving up that time in the future.

“I really feel like I'm happy with how I drove. It just took two whole stints to try and get this car to turn. And then once it started to turn in the third stint, I was back on pace with the guys ahead. But it's a big gap to close. It's eight, nine seconds or whatever it was to the car ahead, and those guys were obviously very quick. So, I’ve just got to work on not losing that.”
Meanwhile, Leclerc took Ferrari’s third-consecutive podium finish but was disappointed to end up 13 seconds adrift of race winner Kimi Antonelli.

“I enjoyed it,” the Monegasque commented. “The start was fun, then later on with Lando [Norris] and Max again was quite fun. So, it's one of those races where you're not getting too bored inside the cockpit and there's something to play for.

“I even thought the victory was possible at one point when I saw Kimi going for the one-stop. Based on our numbers, he would start to struggle a bit more towards the end of the race. He never really struggled towards the end of the race, but, yeah, it's been a fun race. A shame just that we came short of winning.”
Ferrari is now on a nine-round winless streak and despite recent encouraging signs, Leclerc is unsure he can turn his pace into victory soon.
“Whether I can convert that into a win is a bit difficult to predict, because it's such fine margins, and it also depends on what the upgrade plans of the others are in upcoming races,” he said.

“But the feeling with the car is getting better and better. These cars are very specific and unique, and I feel like, over the last two or three races, I've unlocked something again in terms of driving, and particularly set-up with my driving. Just both together, we've taken a step forward, and I just feel much more comfortable with the car.
“So I hope that this will result in a win soon. Whether it's in Singapore or here in Austin, we were quite close, so I'm confident that we'll have a shot to win a race before the end of the season.”

items.originalTitle: McLaren boss claims the MCL40 had podium pace despite a “disappointing” P5 and P7
items.summaryEn: McLaren team boss Andrea Stella admitted that the team's qualifying blunder ruined a guaranteed podium, but he praised his drivers' race execution.
detailZh: 迈凯伦领队称MCL40有领奖台速度，但P5和P7令人失望
安德烈亚·斯特拉承认迈凯伦的排位赛失误毁掉了原本稳拿的领奖台，但他称赞了车手在正赛中的执行表现
兰多·诺里斯，迈凯伦，奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里，迈凯伦
致迈凯伦车迷。来自沃金的木瓜色新闻，带来车手、赛车、车队策略以及每个比赛周末的最新消息。
在现代一级方程式赛车中，如果你在周六下午的排位赛里彻底搞砸了，纯粹的正赛速度就毫无意义。没有赛道位置，你只是在脏空气中白白消耗轮胎，而领跑者则扬长而去。
这就是迈凯伦在美国大奖赛上面临的现实。
尽管为美洲赛道带来了一套非常有效的升级套件，兰多·诺里斯和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里仍不得不分别屈居第五和第七。赛后，迈凯伦车队领队安德烈亚·斯特拉无法掩饰对车队错失巨大机会的恼怒。
虽然周日的执行几乎完美无瑕，斯特拉却直接将矛头指向车队周六的低迷，称这是他们无缘喷洒香槟的唯一原因。
“在令人失望的周六之后迎来一个还算不错的周日：这就是奥斯汀周末的总结，”斯特拉在赛后媒体简报会上解释道。“今天的比赛表明，MCL40依然有能力争夺领奖台，但很明显，我们在发车格上的位置让这个目标几乎无法实现。”
被困在中游车阵中意味着诺里斯和皮亚斯特里整个下午都在追赶，而不是向前方领跑者发起进攻。
“整个车队都有一种共同的挫败感，因为我们在排位赛中没有充分发挥出自己的潜力，但我们必须努力做得更好，”斯特拉承认道。
尽管令人沮丧，但升级版MCL40背后的基础数据非常令人鼓舞。诺里斯在干净空气中展现了致命的节奏，而皮亚斯特里则证明了他的防守驾驶技术完全无懈可击。
当梅赛德斯的乔治·拉塞尔试图从第1圈罚时中恢复时，他追上了皮亚斯特里变速箱的尾部，并在那里待了半场比赛。
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯，奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里，迈凯伦，兰多·诺里斯，迈凯伦
“车队和车手们配合得非常好，无论是在策略决策还是赛道驾驶方面，我们带来的升级也做出了积极贡献，”斯特拉指出。“兰多展现了出色的速度，奥斯卡跑了一场强劲的比赛，抵挡住拉塞尔的梅赛德斯大约三十圈，从未给他任何超车的机会。”
对斯特拉来说，这个周末最大的胜利或许是避免了新加坡大奖赛的重演——当时他的两位车手相撞。在兰多·诺里斯本周早些时候透露他因该事件受到管理层“多次训斥”后，这对木瓜色组合终于在得克萨斯州友好相处。
斯特拉表示：“我也很高兴看到我们的车手在赛道上如何协作，始终牢记首要任务，也就是迈凯伦万事达卡车队的最大利益。”
尽管他们避免了队内灾难，但如果迈凯伦想要在车队积分榜上追赶红牛——后者刚刚跃升至第三——那么带回第五和第七名是不够的。
斯特拉总结道：“显然，第五名和第七名不是我们能满意的成绩，但我们必须接受它并努力改进。我们希望以强势表现结束赛季，不仅力争登上领奖台，还要争取胜利，目标是至少以第三名完成赛季。”
detailEn: McLaren boss claims the MCL40 had podium pace despite a “disappointing” P5 and P7
Andrea Stella admits McLaren's qualifying blunder ruined a guaranteed podium, but praised his drivers' race execution
Lando Norris, McLaren, Oscar Piastri, McLaren
For McLaren fans. Papaya news from Woking, with the latest on the drivers, the car, team strategy and every race weekend.

In modern Formula 1, raw race pace means absolutely nothing if you completely bottle your qualifying laps on Saturday afternoon. Without track position, you are simply burning up your tyres in dirty air while the race leaders cruise off into the distance.
That is the reality McLaren faced at the United States Grand Prix.

Despite bringing a highly effective upgrade package to the Circuit of the Americas, Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri were forced to settle for fifth and seventh, respectively. Following the race, McLaren team principal Andrea Stella couldn't hide his annoyance over the team squandering a massive opportunity.
While the Sunday execution was nearly flawless, Stella pointed a direct finger at the team's Saturday slump as the sole reason they missed out on spraying champagne.

“A decent Sunday following a disappointing Saturday: that sums up the weekend in Austin," Stella explained during his post-race media debrief. "Today’s race showed that the MCL40 is still capable of fighting for the podium, but it’s clear that our position on the starting grid made that goal virtually unattainable."
Getting stuck in the midfield traffic jam meant Norris and Piastri spent the entire afternoon playing catch-up instead of attacking the leaders.
"There is a shared sense of frustration across the whole team at not having fully exploited our potential during qualifying, but it is up to us to try and do better," Stella admitted.

Despite the frustration, the underlying data from the upgraded MCL40 was incredibly promising. Norris showed lethal pace in clean air, while Piastri proved his defensive racecraft is completely bulletproof.
When Mercedes' George Russell tried to recover from a lap 1 penalty, he came up against the back of Piastri's gearbox and stayed there for half the race.
George Russell, Mercedes, Oscar Piastri, McLaren, Lando Norris, McLaren

"The team and the drivers worked very well, both in terms of strategic decisions and driving on the track, and the upgrades we brought here made a positive contribution," Stella noted. "Lando showed excellent pace, and Oscar drove a strong race, holding off Russell’s Mercedes for around thirty laps without ever giving him a chance to overtake."

Perhaps the biggest win of the weekend for Stella was avoiding a repeat of the Singapore Grand Prix, where his two drivers crashed into each other. After Lando Norris revealed earlier in the week that he received "plenty of telling-offs" from management over the incident, the papaya duo finally played nice in Texas.
"I was also pleased to see how our drivers worked together on the track, keeping in mind what the priority is, namely McLaren Mastercard’s best interests," Stella said.
While they avoided intra-team disaster, bringing home P5 and P7 isn't going to cut it if McLaren wants to hunt down Red Bull—who just leapfrogged into third—in the constructors' championship.

“Clearly, a fifth and a seventh place are not results we can be satisfied with, but we must accept it and work to improve," Stella concluded. "We want to end the season on a high and aim not only to fight for the podium but also for victory, with the aim of finishing the championship in at least third place.”

items.summaryZh: 贝尔曼对美国大奖赛上与加斯利的碰撞被罚10秒感到“相当震惊”，他认为这次判罚过于严厉，而这次碰撞最终也导致他退赛。

items.originalTitle: “I couldn’t disappear” – Oliver Bearman rues “crazy” penalty for Pierre Gasly clash
items.summaryEn: Oliver Bearman says he was "pretty shocked" to receive a 10-second penalty for his collision with Pierre Gasly at the United States Grand Prix, feeling the penalty was harsh, and the clash ultimately led to his retirement anyway.
detailZh: “我无法凭空消失”——奥利弗·贝尔曼对与皮埃尔·加斯利碰撞被罚感到不满
在贝尔曼看来，他对加斯利的这次大胆超车被严厉处罚，而这次碰撞最终还是导致他退赛
奥利弗·贝尔曼表示，他在F1美国大奖赛上与皮埃尔·加斯利发生碰撞后被罚10秒，对此他感到“相当震惊”。
贝尔曼在奥斯汀站比赛首圈上升了两个位置，并在下一圈于13号弯从内线对第10位的加斯利发起进攻。
意识到差距正在消失，贝尔曼将两个车轮压上黄色的内侧路肩，但他的左前轮仍然碰到了阿尔派的侧箱；这次接触虽然轻微，却对两辆车造成了严重损坏，FIA干事因此对这位英国车手处以10秒罚时。
“说实话，我相当震惊，”贝尔曼说。“这充其量只是一次比赛事故。我觉得因为这件事被罚10秒有点冤，尤其是考虑到今年发生的一些事件要么没有被处罚，要么只罚了5秒。在我看来，鉴于当时发生的情况，对这类事件处以10秒罚时似乎太过分了。
“我觉得我的赛车有足够的部分并排，足以证明——或者说让我觉得——我应该获得一点空间，但并没有真正得到那个空间。我只被给了大约半个车宽。我爬上路肩试图避免接触，但我就是做不到。一旦我决定发起这个动作，我就无法凭空消失。我没有锁死轮胎，我没有失去任何控制，只是简单地在那个阶段我无法消失。鉴于所有这些事实，10秒的处罚太疯狂了。
“说实话，更具惩罚性的是我受了一点损伤。那是一次非常轻微的触碰，但它基本上松动了底板，然后在接下来的几圈里慢慢振动脱落，赛车就在不断恶化。我大概有五圈感觉非常好、一切正常，然后慢慢地、一步一步地，赛车越来越差，然后基本上就完蛋了。”
这次损伤导致贝尔曼在第11圈让队友埃斯特班·奥康通过。
“皮埃尔超越了我，但我仍然感觉相对有竞争力，”这位哈斯车手继续说道。“前面皮埃尔和后面埃斯特班之间的差距非常稳定；只有一秒多一点。
“但随后从一圈到下一圈，我们看到有东西从车上掉落。在第一赛段，我一圈到下一圈就损失了大约零点八秒。很明显，我突然从车上有一点损伤变成了车上有灾难性的损伤。
“我就说，‘我已经不在这个竞争行列了，我要让埃斯特班过去’。他正要超过去，我只是不想挡住他，因为那不是我来比赛的目的。我们作为一个团队比赛，努力击败奥迪，所以我一有机会就让他过去了。”
贝尔曼最终在第24圈因早先的碰撞直接退赛。“情况越来越糟，变得很危险，”他说。“我的意思是，赛车非常难以预测，除此之外，你知道，引擎和所有部件的里程数都很重要。”
与此同时，加斯利在方格旗挥动时以落后利亚姆·劳森八秒的差距守住了第10位，但他觉得与贝尔曼的碰撞让他无法挑战小红牛。
“那是一次轻微的接触，但它在我们底板右侧切掉了相当大的一块，比如底板前部和中部；我认为我们损失了接近10个（下压力）点，所以这确实让我们的下午变得不太轻松，”这位法国车手说。
“考虑到我们排在第10位，还算满意。只是，我本想知道如果没有那次损伤，对阵利亚姆会有怎样的可能。我们永远不会知道了。”
detailEn: “I couldn’t disappear” – Oliver Bearman rues “crazy” penalty for Pierre Gasly clash
Bearman’s bold move on Gasly was, in his view, harshly penalized – and caused his retirement anyway
Oliver Bearman says he was “pretty shocked” to land a 10-second penalty for his collision with Pierre Gasly in Formula 1’s United States Grand Prix.
Bearman gained two spots on the opening lap of the Austin race and made a move on 10th-placed Gasly on the next tour, down the inside in Turn 13.

Realising the gap was disappearing, Bearman put two wheels on the yellow inside kerb, but his front-left wheel still touched the Alpine’s sidepod; the contact, albeit tenuous, caused significant damage to both cars, and FIA stewards hit the Briton with that 10-second penalty.

“I was pretty shocked to be honest,” Bearman said. “If anything, it was a racing incident. I felt a bit hard done by for it to be a 10-second penalty as well, especially given some of the incidents that have happened this year that have gone either unpenalized or five-second penalty. Ten seconds for that type of incident seems very excessive in my opinion, given what happened.

“I felt like I had enough of my car alongside to justify, or to kind of feel like I earned a bit of space, and didn't really get that space. I was given maybe half a car width. I was climbing up onto the kerb trying to avoid contact, but I simply couldn't. I couldn't disappear once I decided to go for the move. I didn't lock up, I didn't lose any control, it was just simply I couldn't disappear at that stage. Ten seconds is crazy, given all of those facts.

“To be honest, the more penalizing thing was that I picked up a bit of damage. It was a very small touch, but it loosened basically the floorboard and that slowly vibrated its way off over the next few laps, and the car was just deteriorating. I had maybe five laps where I was actually feeling very good and everything was fine and then slowly, step by step, the car was getting worse and then it was game over basically.”
The damage led Bearman to let team-mate Esteban Ocon through on lap 11.
“Pierre overtook me and I still felt relatively competitive,” the Haas driver continued. “The gap was very stable between Pierre in front and Esteban behind; it was just over one second.

“But then from one lap to the next, we saw something fall off the car. And in sector one, I lost something like eight tenths to myself from one lap to the next. It was very clear that suddenly I went from having a bit of damage on the car to having a catastrophic amount of damage on the car.

“I just said, ‘I'm not in this race anymore, I'm going to let Esteban go’. He was coming past, I just didn't want to hold him up because that's not what I'm racing for. We're racing as a team to try and beat Audi, so I let him go at the earliest opportunity.”

Bearman eventually retired from the race on lap 24 as a direct consequence of the earlier collision. “It was getting worse, it was getting dangerous,” he said. “I mean, the car was very unpredictable, and on top of that, you know, mileage on the engine and all of the parts are important.”

Meanwhile, Gasly held on to that 10th position with an eight-second deficit to Liam Lawson under the chequered flag, but he felt the clash with Bearman had prevented him from challenging the Racing Bulls.

“It was a small touch, but it just took quite a big chunk out of our right part of the floor, like on the front of the floor and then the mid part of it; I think we were down close to 10 [downforce] points, so it didn't really make our afternoon very easy,” the Frenchman said.
“Pleased, considering that we were 10th. Just, I would have liked to see what would have been possible against Liam without that damage. We'll never know.”

items.originalTitle: Toto Wolff dismisses Helmut Marko's Russell theory: "He still has what it takes"
detailZh: 托托·沃尔夫否认赫尔穆特·马克尔的拉塞尔理论："他仍有所需的一切"
梅赛德斯首席执行官认为乔治·拉塞尔可以从即将到来的一级方程式世界冠军失败中抹去一切
梅赛德斯一级方程式车队老板托托·沃尔夫驳斥了前红牛顾问赫尔穆特·马克尔关于乔治·拉塞尔在未能赢得世界冠军后无法东山再起的观点。
安东内利预计将在即将到来的墨西哥城大奖赛中加冕，除非出现特殊情况推迟他的加冕仪式。
随着梅赛德斯凭借全新的2026年规定占据领先，这为长期效力于梅赛德斯的拉塞尔提供了一个争夺世界冠军的绝佳机会，但这位英国人却一直被他的经验较少的队友所掩盖，他在年初连续赢得了五场比赛，从而掌控了积分榜。
拉塞尔在夏季休赛期后短暂地复兴了一段时间，但由于新车的操控问题和可靠性方面的不幸，这位27岁的车手从未看起来有可能击败安东内利，现在他面临失去第二名给法拉利的莱维斯·汉密尔顿的危险。
天空体育德国评论员、前红牛顾问赫尔穆特·马克奥，去年年底离开了该团队，他认为拉塞尔从20岁队友那里遭受的失败后无法再回来。
马克奥说：“拉塞尔不再是一号车手。”当安东内利在奥斯汀的美国大奖赛中赢得本赛季的第九场胜利时，拉塞尔以第八名的成绩完赛。
"安东内利显然已经取代了他的位置。我怀疑他是否还有机会再次获得世界冠军，或者在任何地方获得一号车手的地位。"
在墨尔本的开赛周末赢得胜利之后，乔治·拉塞尔在整个2026年都被他的年轻队友所掩盖。
赛后，沃尔夫驳回了马克的评论，坚持认为，有了清白的名声和更适合他驾驶风格的赛车，拉塞尔仍然可以争夺世界冠军。
"赫尔穆特，他是我的奥地利非好友，但我尊重他的意见，"沃尔夫说。"但我认为他在乔治的问题上是错的。乔治拥有所有的能力。我认为赛车不适合他。"
“我认为赛季初，当你觉得自己今年会一鸣惊人时，而另一边却有一个天才少年开始真正地削弱你的优势，这样的处境可能很难应对。”
“我相信，在新赛季，乔治，如果我们能给他一辆快速的车，他绝对有赢得冠军的能力。”
“所以，我认为忘记他在F2和F3中赢得的冠军，他的新秀赛季，以及他在卡丁车赛中的连续欧洲冠军，这些都太过容易了。”
安东内利在本周末的墨西哥站比赛中以123分的领先优势进入，剩下五场比赛还有125分可以赢得。如果拉塞尔能在赫尔曼诺斯·罗德里格斯赛道赢得比赛，安东内利只需要获得第九名就能成为F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军。如果汉密尔顿获胜，这位20岁的年轻人只需要在第十名中获得一个积分就能达到目标。”
detailEn: Toto Wolff dismisses Helmut Marko's Russell theory: "He still has what it takes"
Mercedes chief is adamant George Russell can wipe the slate clean from impending Formula 1 title defeat to Kimi Antonelli
Mercedes F1 boss Toto Wolff has dismissed suggestions from former Red Bull advisor Helmut Marko that there's no coming back for George Russell from being beaten to the world title by Kimi Antonelli.
Antonelli is set to be crowned in the upcoming Mexico City Grand Prix barring exceptional circumstances delaying his coronation by one week.

As Mercedes hit the front with the all-new 2026 regulations, it provided long-time Mercedes driver Russell with a golden chance to fight for the world title, but the Briton has been largely overshadowed by his less experienced team-mate, who won five consecutive races at the start of the year to take charge of the standings.

Russell enjoyed a brief resurgence after the summer break, but through a combination of handling struggles with the new cars and bad luck with reliability the 27-year-old never looked liked to defeat Antonelli and he is now under threat of losing second to Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton.
Sky Germany pundit and former Red Bull advisor Helmut Marko, who left the outfit at the end of last year, believes there's no coming back for Russell from that defeat to his 20-year-old team-mate.
"Russell is no longer the number one driver." Marko said as Antonelli took his ninth win of the season in Austin's United States Grand Prix while Russell came home in eighth.
"Antonelli has quite ​clearly taken that spot from him. I doubt whether he'll ever have ​another chance at the world title or be given number one status anywhere."
Following an opening weekend win in Melbourne, George Russell has been shaded by his younger team-mate throughout 2026.
After the race, Wolff dismissed Marko's comments, insisting that with a clean slate and a car more suited to his driving style, Russell can still contend for world championships.
"Helmut, he's my Austrian not-so-buddy, but I respect his opinion," Wolff said. "But I think he's wrong on George. George has all the ability. I think the car doesn't suit him.

"I think that at the beginning of the season it's maybe difficult to cope with a situation where you're feeling like this is my year to come, and then you have this wunderkind [wonderkid] on the other side that starts to really chip away.
"And I believe that in a new season, George, if we provide him a quick car, he has absolutely what it takes to win a championship.

"So, I think it's a bit too easy to say, let's forget about all these years where he won in F2 and F3, his rookie years and the European championships back-to-back in karting, that's still all there."

Antonelli heads into this weekend's Mexico race with a 123-point lead on Russell and 125 points left to earn over the remaining five races. If Russell manages to win at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez, all Antonelli needs is ninth place to become the youngest world champion in F1 history. If Hamilton takes victory, a solitary point in 10th would be enough for the 20-year-old.
keyPointsZh: 除非出现特殊情况，否则他的加冕仪式不会推迟
keyPointsEn: His coronation will not be delayed unless there are exceptional circumstances
